name: Oc huong hap sa
summary: Ốc hương steamed with lemongrass, in the night-market meal Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu describes. Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu also lists ốc among the seafood you choose on the stalls. A price for the snails alone was not printed.
origin: Chợ đêm Côn Đảo. Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, 16 May 2025.
howToEat: Choose the snails and have them steamed with lemongrass. The market opens at 17:00.
A snail price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng, in front of the daily market.
seoTitle: Oc huong hap sa — lemongrass snails in Con Dao
seoDescription: Ốc hương hấp sả is lemongrass-steamed snail at the Côn Đảo night market. A snail price was not printed. Check on arrival.
